fr_html: Sur l'invitation du PRESIDENT, M. DE LAPRADELLE continue et achève la lecture de son rapport, dont quelques points donnent lieu à des discussions et à des amendements.
en_html: At the request of the PRESIDENT, M. DE LAPRADELLE continued and completed the reading of his report; several points in it gave rise to discussion and were amended.
